podcast.title: Impact on Orchestral Soundtracks
podcast.body: John Williams's work on the "Star Wars" soundtrack reclaimed significant space for orchestral music in an era when pop music was increasingly dominating film soundtracks. "He reclaimed some space for the orchestral soundtrack."

podcast.title: Inspiration to Musicians
podcast.body: The "Star Wars" soundtrack was so impactful that, according to critic Alex Ross in 2016, it inspired some members of the London Symphony to learn to play their instruments. Composer Andrew Norman decided to learn to write music after watching "Star Wars" on video. "Alex Ross, the longtime movie critic for The New Yorker, wrote in 2016 that the Star Wars soundtrack inspired some members of the London Symphony to learn to play their instruments because they heard the song in Star Wars."

podcast.title: Oscar Nominations
